name: playosx
description: A controller-first game launcher for Windows with a PS5-style interface (multi-language)
author: Esma3iL Magdey

scripts.start: node scripts/fetch-concentus.js && node scripts/build-native.js && node scripts/fetch-libviiper.js && node scripts/fetch-presentmon.js && node scripts/fetch-ytdlp.js && electron .
scripts.dev: node scripts/fetch-concentus.js && node scripts/build-native.js && node scripts/fetch-libviiper.js && node scripts/fetch-presentmon.js && node scripts/fetch-ytdlp.js && electron . --dev
scripts.dist: node scripts/fetch-concentus.js && node scripts/build-native.js && node scripts/fetch-libviiper.js && node scripts/fetch-presentmon.js && node scripts/fetch-ytdlp.js && electron-builder --win
scripts.dist:dir: node scripts/fetch-concentus.js && node scripts/build-native.js && node scripts/fetch-libviiper.js && node scripts/fetch-presentmon.js && node scripts/fetch-ytdlp.js && electron-builder --win dir
